Names, chart types and settings shared by the plotters

Source: R/visgen.R
rvis-constants.Rd

valid.dim.names lists the dimension arguments of the wrappers (like x, y, color, size, label, source or linkWidth): the columns of the data a wrapper maps to its chart. valid.plot.types and valid.plotters are short lists kept for backward compatibility; the complete list of chart types and plotters is in the chart type and plotter reference and in the plotters data set. defset holds the default settings that every wrapper's own defaults are built on: the colour and shape palettes, withRowNames and colorize.

Format

Character vectors (valid.dim.names, valid.plot.types, valid.plotters) and a list (defset).

See also

rvisPlot, plotters, properties.

Examples

valid.dim.names
#>  [1] "key"            "x"              "y"              "y2"            
#>  [5] "z"              "t"              "high"           "low"           
#>  [9] "color"          "size"           "shape"          "label"         
#> [13] "tooltip"        "labelColor"     "borderColor"    "linkColor"     
#> [17] "theta"          "ySide"          "group"          "source"        
#> [21] "target"         "linkWidth"      "linkLength"     "linkLabel"     
#> [25] "linkLabelColor" "linkLabelSize"  "linkTooltip"   
defset$palette$color
#> [1] "purple" "blue"   "cyan"   "green"  "yellow" "orange" "red"    "black" 
#> [9] "white"
